note: rename-map.json has two sections, recovered by token alignment from the committed slices (tools/recover-scoped-map.mjs) and re-applied by tools/apply-record — never edited by hand. `files[slice]` is a word-boundary map, used only where a name means the same thing everywhere in the slice, is never a property or object key, and every occurrence was renamed. `scoped[slice]` addresses the rest by exact token index as { name: [[i, target], ...] }: the minifier reused short names across scopes and those same names are keys (`t.x`, `{x: .3}`), so neither one-to-one nor occurrence-counting can express them. `files` is authoritative per slice. The reviewed rule list that produced these slices is tools/names.json; the gates are tools/verify-rename.mjs and tools/check-chunk.mjs.
